register_map.index_space: Local observer index is the 13-bit index_i routed as (legacy_index - 512) from the legacy 13-bit index. Legacy indices 512..8191 map to local 0x0000..0x1DFF. All multi-byte values are little-endian 64-bit words read through one 64-bit rdata_o.

access.RW: writable; write is rejected with a sticky error when the state precondition fails

0x0001.name: MAGIC1
0x0001.note: low byte 0x08 is the v8 observer magic

modes.3: reserved/invalid; E2 and COST are mutually exclusive
modes.write_rule: MODE is writable only while E2 phase==IDLE and no COST session is active; bits[63:2] must be zero

e2_phases.note: ARM_A -> READY is autonomous at exactly T_CYCLES after the ARM_A acceptance cycle; PROBE is an explicit command accepted only in READY (phase code 6, also status bit 6).

legality.ARM_WARM: MODE_E2, phase IDLE, quiet, supported, SRC/DST configured; resets E2 session evidence but not sticky errors
legality.ARM_A: MODE_E2, phase ARM_WARM, quiet, supported, both targets valid and present as ordinary S1-only non-global 4K entries, no same-edge update/invalidate; takes the warm snapshot
legality.FREEZE: MODE_E2, phase PROBE, quiet, supported, firstprobe_done==2'b11, no same-edge update/invalidate; takes the freeze snapshot
legality.ABORT: MODE_E2 and phase in ARM_WARM/ARM_A/READY/PROBE; freezes observation, produces no DMA output
legality.CLEAR: MODE_E2, phase in IDLE/FREEZE/ABORT, quiet; returns to IDLE, clears sticky E2 errors/overflow, keeps snapshots, events, counters and timestamps readable

registers.name: COMMAND
registers.layout: [3:0] command, [63:4]=0; reads back the last command value written

registers.name: ASTART
registers.desc: EPOCH value latched in the cycle in which ARM_A was accepted

registers.name: A_ELAPSED
registers.desc: cycles since the first ARM_A cycle, frozen at T_CYCLES when READY is entered

registers.name: EPOCH
registers.desc: monotonic epoch, 0 at the first ARM_WARM cycle, never reset by ARM_A

registers.name: QUIET_TIMEOUT
registers.desc: deadline edges observed with quiet_i low

registers.name: TARGET0_KEY_LO
registers.desc: raw128 bits [63:0] of the captured source-page entry

registers.name: TARGET0_KEY_HI
registers.desc: raw128 bits [127:64]; gscid at [15:0]

registers.name: FP0_TIME
registers.desc: EPOCH at the first PROBE lookup matching the source target

layout.15:0: live presence bitmap of target0 identity in entries_i at that lookup
layout.31:16: live presence bitmap of the other target (target1) at that lookup

registers.name: FP0_KEY_LO
registers.desc: raw128 of the matched live ordinary entry if present, else raw128 of the lookup context

registers.name: DEADLINE
registers.desc: ASTART + T_CYCLES; equals EPOCH in the cycle of the ARM_A->READY transition edge

registers.name: PROBESTART
registers.desc: EPOCH in the cycle PROBE was accepted

registers.name: FREEZE_TIME
registers.desc: EPOCH in the cycle FREEZE was accepted

registers.name: E2_A_ISSUE_COUNT
registers.desc: lane-1 issue count in E2 phases

registers.name: E2_A_DONE_COUNT
registers.desc: lane-1 done count in E2 phases

registers.name: E2_A_FIRST_ISSUE
registers.desc: EPOCH of the first accepted lane-1 issue

registers.name: E2_A_LAST_DONE
registers.desc: EPOCH of the most recent accepted lane-1 done

registers.name: SRC_IOVA
registers.desc: page aligned, writable only in phase IDLE while no COST session runs

registers.name: DST_IOVA
registers.desc: page aligned and different from SRC_IOVA

registers.name: SNAPSHOT_WARM
registers.desc: 32 words: entry i occupies 2*i (bits 63:0) and 2*i+1 (bits 127:64); zero unless snapshot_valid[0]

registers.name: SNAPSHOT_DEADLINE
registers.desc: same layout, guarded by snapshot_valid[1]

registers.name: SNAPSHOT_FREEZE
registers.desc: same layout, guarded by snapshot_valid[2]

registers.name: EVENT_LOG
registers.desc: 6 consecutive words per event n (0<=n<EVENT_COUNT<=256); reads beyond EVENT_COUNT*6 return 0

registers.name: SAMPLE_LOG
registers.desc: 4 consecutive words per sample n (0<=n<SAMPLE_COUNT<=256); reads beyond SAMPLE_COUNT*4 return 0

registers.name: COST_STATUS
registers.layout: [0] cost active, [1] window open, [2] window closed

registers.name: COST_CYCLES
registers.desc: cycles from p4m_arm through p4m_close inclusive

registers.name: COST_V_MAIN
registers.desc: REQ_TRANS+AWAIT_RESP cycles while ctl_did_i==10, whole session

registers.name: COST_A_MAIN
registers.desc: REQ_TRANS+AWAIT_RESP cycles while ctl_did_i==11, whole session

registers.name: COST_V_COMPLETE
registers.desc: COMPLETE cycles while ctl_did_i==10, whole session

registers.name: COST_A_COMPLETE
registers.desc: COMPLETE cycles while ctl_did_i==11, whole session

registers.name: COST_V_SELECT
registers.desc: select_fire_i && select_did_i==10

registers.name: COST_A_SELECT
registers.desc: select_fire_i && select_did_i==11 (never REQ_TRANS state cycles)

registers.name: COST_V_FIRST_HIT
registers.desc: lookup_i && lookup_hit_i && lookup_did_i==10

registers.name: COST_V_FIRST_MISS
registers.desc: lookup_i && !lookup_hit_i && lookup_did_i==10

registers.name: COST_A_FIRST_HIT
registers.desc: lookup_i && lookup_hit_i && lookup_did_i==11

registers.name: COST_A_FIRST_MISS
registers.desc: lookup_i && !lookup_hit_i && lookup_did_i==11

registers.name: COST_OWNER_ERR_COUNT
registers.desc: cycles/events with an owner outside {10,11}

registers.name: COST_A_DONE_ALL
registers.desc: all lane-1 done in the session (eligible ordinal is separate)

registers.name: COST_ELIGIBLE
registers.desc: fully contained completed A copies; sampling ordinal

registers.name: COST_CARRY_IN
registers.layout: [0] lane 1 active in the cycle p4m_open was applied

registers.name: COST_CARRY_OUT
registers.layout: [0] lane 1 still active after the done applied in the p4m_close cycle

registers.name: WINDOW_CYCLES
registers.desc: cycles in (p4m_open, p4m_close], opening edge excluded, closing edge included

registers.name: CUR_A_MAIN
registers.desc: in-flight A copy, kept from accepted issue until done

registers.name: CUR_A_REQ
registers.desc: select_fire && select_did==11 while the copy is in flight

registers.name: CUR_A_MISS
registers.desc: lookup && !hit && lookup_did==11 while the copy is in flight

registers.name: CUR_A_FLAGS
registers.layout: [0] issued before window open, [1] issued after window close, [2] contained (eligible), [3] done on the closing edge

registers.name: LANE_OWNER
registers.layout: [23:0] lane0 owner = 24'h00000A, [47:24] lane1 owner = 24'h00000B; hardwired constants

register_map.counter_widths: All counters read as 64-bit registers. Internally the COST aggregate and window counters are CounterWidth wide (default 64) and set COST_ERR[2] on wrap; per-copy A/V counters and the sample record fields are fixed 32-bit; timestamps, epoch, astart, deadline, probestart and freeze are fixed 64-bit.

word_hi.note: bits [127:80] of the 128-bit entry are always zero

register_map.identity_match: vpn[28:0], pscid[19:0], gscid[15:0], en1, en2 equality; ordinary target additionally requires valid=1, en1=1, en2=0, all S1/S2 superpage bits 0 and S1 global 0.

e2_err_bits.0: invalid command or invalid/reserved configuration write
e2_err_bits.1: more than one entry changed in one committed update
e2_err_bits.2: invalidation observed during the E2 session (INVAL_COUNT also increments)
e2_err_bits.3: event log overflow (more than EventDepth committed updates)
e2_err_bits.4: quiet_i low at the T deadline edge
e2_err_bits.5: phase guard violation, including any activity during READY
e2_err_bits.6: ARM_A preconditions failed (target missing or not ordinary S1-only non-global 4K)
e2_err_bits.7: snapshot conflict: same-edge update or invalidation at a required quiescent boundary
e2_err_bits.8: committed slot mismatch, replace_mask not one-hot, or same-edge update+invalidate
e2_err_bits.9: unsupported configuration (supported_i low or non-ordinary target geometry)
e2_err_bits.10: lane protocol error (issue while active, done without issue, id mismatch)
e2_err_bits.11: SRC/DST IOVA misaligned, identical to the other port, or written outside IDLE
e2_err_bits.12: unknown owner/context for the current phase (DID outside {10,11} or wrong lane owner)
e2_err_bits.13: response_error_i observed in an active E2 phase

cost_err_bits.0: lane protocol error (issue while active, done without issue, id mismatch)
cost_err_bits.2: counter wrap at the configured CounterWidth
cost_err_bits.3: sample store overflow (more than SampleDepth samples)
cost_err_bits.4: window protocol error (open while open, close without a usable open)
cost_err_bits.6: p4m_arm while MODE is not COST, or an invalid MODE field

meta.48: 1 = committed update event (always 1 in the log)

event_record.selection: Slot is the one-hot committed replace_mask, so identical old==new updates are still logged. Invalidation never creates an event record.

sample_record.selection: every 16th fully contained completed A copy using the eligible ordinal (eligible_q[3:0]==15), next-state counts captured including the closing/done edge; carry-in, carry-out and post-close copies are never sampled

timestamp_relations.epoch: increments each cycle in ARM_WARM, ARM_A, READY and PROBE; 0 at the first ARM_WARM cycle; never reset by ARM_A
timestamp_relations.astart: EPOCH latched in the ARM_A acceptance cycle
timestamp_relations.deadline: astart + T_CYCLES; equal to EPOCH in the cycle of the ARM_A->READY transition edge
timestamp_relations.a_elapsed: increments each ARM_A cycle and is frozen at T_CYCLES at the transition edge
timestamp_relations.probestart: EPOCH in the PROBE acceptance cycle
timestamp_relations.freeze: EPOCH in the FREEZE acceptance cycle
timestamp_relations.events: event word 0 is EPOCH at the update edge, monotonic across ARM_WARM, ARM_A and PROBE

assumptions: lookup_i on this observer is qualified by the TL tap as a normal first lookup (contract line 8); no separate normal flag is added, and every lookup seen is treated as a normal lookup.

The E2 target capture stores the actual raw128 of a present ordinary entry (no synthetic key). If the first V lookup to a configured IOVA finds only non-ordinary geometry (global/superpage/S2), E2_ERR[9] is raised and no target is captured.
Invalidation is treated as an error in ARM_WARM as well as ARM_A/READY/PROBE, because the experiment contract only allows explicit S1 flush before warm and between trials.
A second p4m_open inside one p4m_arm..p4m_close session is a window protocol error: one (open, close] window per arm.
COST counting stops at p4m_close (the close edge itself is still counted), so all exported totals and window totals are frozen and later drain cannot change them.
CLEAR only clears the phase and the sticky E2 error/overflow/quiet-timeout state; snapshots, event/sample logs, counters and timestamps stay readable until the next ARM_WARM.

Timestamps observed by the driver are the registered EPOCH values; the deadline invariant is stated at the transition edge (EPOCH == DEADLINE == ASTART + T_CYCLES) and A_ELAPSED == T_CYCLES after that edge.
MODE/command/reserved-write rejections are recorded in E2_ERR[0]; a MODE write requesting both modes also sets COST_ERR[6].
Tests are written for Verilator 4.038 and were not executed by the authoring agent; T_CYCLES is overridden to 64 in simulation while the production default stays 5000000.
unresolved: Actual ctl_state_i encoding of the frozen SV interface must be confirmed against the real design; the observer assumes IDLE=0 REQ_TRANS=1 AWAIT_RESP=2 MRIF=3 COMPLETE=4 and treats any other value as neither main nor complete.
PTW/DDTW optional traffic counters from contract line 10 are not exported; only the required A/V main, complete, select, first-lookup and per-copy fields are implemented.
The legacy dma_observer bank extension (index 512..8191, full-strobe DATA write only in the research bank, index-512 routing) is integration work outside these three files and is not modified here.
Verilator lint cleanliness (-Wall) and timing closure of the two 64-bit event-log writes per event were not verified by execution.
